comparison.objective: Damper commissioning through unlock-adjust-cycle-relock versus static prosthetic-foot pose alignment.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed setscrew engagement, collar tuning, counterholding, and dynamic-response iteration versus placing and orienting a foot to visual offsets.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable energy-absorbing stops, lock retention, and no bottoming versus 30 mm offset and 5° toe-out. The record supplies no specs or fuller scoring rubric.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests physical tuning and retention of a dynamic damper; the record tests geometric bench alignment.
